description: 9 1/2% 10-year note accruing from 1985-11-15, issued 1985-11-29 due 1995-11-15, priced at 9.54%: settlement inside a regular period, A = (14/181)(C/2).

reference.convention: Treasury non-indexed note/bond: actual/actual (ICMA-equivalent) semi-annual accrual; price per 100 rounded to six places; fractional first period discounted at simple interest [1 + (r/s)(i/2)]
reference.source: 31 CFR Part 356, Appendix B, Section II (via law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356), Section II.D

_pricing.reason: Treasury formula discounts the fractional first period at simple interest [1 + (r/s)(i/2)]; the library's street yield compounds it [(1 + i/2)^(r/s)]. Verified: substituting the simple-interest factor into the library's own cash flows reproduces the printed price to the 6th decimal.
